supplements.title: Preventive Health Behaviours Among Elderly in India: Does Social Capital Matter?
supplements.summary: Social connections and community ties help elderly Indians adopt preventive health behaviors like exercise, cancer screening, and vaccinations.

supplements.title: In silico evaluation of garlic-derived organosulfur compounds as multi-target inhibitors of breast cancer biomarkers.
supplements.summary: Garlic compounds, especially Z-ajoene, show promise as multi-target breast cancer treatments with good safety profiles in computational studies.

supplements.title: Rapid regression of advanced hepatic fibrosis in a patient with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and severe obesity: a case report highlighting lifestyle-induced NETosis activation through serum proteomic analysis.
supplements.summary: Intensive lifestyle intervention reversed advanced liver fibrosis in a severely obese patient, potentially through immune pathway activation.

supplements.title: CD44-Targeting Hydroxyapatite Nanoparticles (HAP) Induce Mitochondrial Dysfunction-Driven PANoptosis and Immunogenic Cell Death (ICD) via Ca Overload in Colorectal Cancer.
supplements.summary: Targeted nanoparticles trigger multiple death pathways in colorectal cancer cells, boosting immune response and overcoming treatment resistance.

supplements.title: The TRIM27/STING Axis Mediates Schisandrin B-Induced Inhibition of Myeloid-Derived Suppressor Cells Accumulation to Potentiate Anti-PD-1 Immunotherapy in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Schisandrin B enhances anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in hepatocellular carcinoma by reducing immune-suppressive cells through the TRIM27/STING pathway.

supplements.title: Akkermansia muciniphila-derived 5-MIAA blunts colitis-associated tumorigenesis by modulating colonic SLC26A3/pSTAT3 signaling.
supplements.summary: A bacterial metabolite from *Akkermansia muciniphila* reduces colorectal cancer growth by activating a protective signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Urinary phytoestrogens and hyperuricemia risk in a nationally representative population: an effect modified by smoking status.
supplements.summary: Higher urinary phytoestrogens are associated with lower hyperuricemia risk in U.S. adults, especially among current smokers.

supplements.title: The association of time-restricted eating and indices of organ-specific aging in relation to metabolic health and obesity.
supplements.summary: Moderate time-restricted eating with timely breakfast is associated with slower organ aging and better metabolic health compared to extreme eating patterns.

supplements.title: ROS-Responsive Polyprodrug Co-Delivery of Curcumin and Cinnamaldehyde to Disrupt Tumor Redox Homeostasis for Anticancer Therapy.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed nanoparticles combining curcumin and cinnamaldehyde that respond to cancer cell stress signals, effectively killing breast cancer cells and shrinking tumors.

supplements.title: Fasting opens a metabolic window that favors anti-tumor immunity.
supplements.summary: Short-term fasting boosts tumor-fighting immune cells by increasing a nutrient that strengthens their anti-cancer activity.

supplements.title: A small molecule disrupts G4-STAT1 interaction and synergizes with olaparib to drive cancer cell death.
supplements.summary: Berberine and coptisine block a cancer protein's growth signals and enhance DNA-damaging therapy in colon cancer cells.

supplements.title: 16-h fasting optimizes cancer immunotherapy in mice and humans.
supplements.summary: A 16-hour fasting period boosts cancer immunotherapy effectiveness by improving immune cells' tumor-fighting capacity in mice and humans.

supplements.title: Indole-3-Carbaldehyde from Limosilactobacillus reuteri Boosts Chemotherapy Response in Diffuse Large B Cell Lymphoma by Blocking the Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin Pathway.
supplements.summary: A beneficial gut bacterium produces a compound that enhances chemotherapy effectiveness and reduces side effects in diffuse large B cell lymphoma.

supplements.title: The Extract of Rosa roxburghii Tratt Alleviates Pulmonary Fibrosis in Mice via Gut Microbiota-Amino Acid Metabolism and JAK2/STAT3 Inhibition.
supplements.summary: Rosa roxburghii extract reduces pulmonary fibrosis in mice by reshaping gut bacteria and blocking a key inflammatory pathway.

supplements.title: Cannabinoids in the Treatment of Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials.
supplements.summary: Cannabinoids showed no significant benefit over placebo for treating chemotherapy-induced nerve pain in limited clinical trials.

off_label.title: CKS1B is a tumor-intrinsic factor driving CD8+ T cell exhaustion via maintaining persistent tumor-antigen stimulation.
off_label.summary: CKS1B protein in esophageal cancer tumors exhausts immune cells; blocking it restores anti-tumor immunity and improves checkpoint therapy.

off_label.title: Dutasteride treatment and its effect on standardized uptake values in prostate-specific membrane antigen-PET imaging: A pilot study.
off_label.summary: Dutasteride treatment increased PSMA expression in prostate cancer patients, potentially improving the effectiveness of PSMA-PET imaging for detection.

off_label.title: Enhancing CAR-T Cell Efficacy in Solid Tumors by Inhibiting CCL5/VEGF-Mediated Angiogenesis.
off_label.summary: Blocking CCL5 signaling in CAR-T cells improves their ability to fight solid tumors by preventing unwanted blood vessel growth.

off_label.title: Molecular Glue cc-885 Inhibits VHL-Deficient Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma via ETS1 Degradation.
off_label.summary: cc-885 drug kills kidney cancer cells with VHL mutations by breaking down ETS1 protein, working better combined with belzutifan.

off_label.title: Safety and efficacy of echinocandin antifungal agents in Candida albicans endophthalmitis.
off_label.summary: Echinocandin antifungal drugs rezafungin and anidulafungin effectively treat Candida albicans eye infections with safety comparable to traditional antifungals.

off_label.title: ERα blockade in dendritic cells enhances antigen cross-presentation and induces antitumor CD8+ T cell immunity.
off_label.summary: Blocking estrogen receptor in immune cells enhances their ability to activate cancer-fighting T cells, offering a potential new immunotherapy approach.

off_label.title: UBA2-High Osteosarcoma Suppresses Immune Infiltration by Autophagy-Mediated MHC-I Degradation.
off_label.summary: UBA2 protein drives osteosarcoma's immune resistance by triggering autophagy that destroys MHC-I, blocking immune cell infiltration and checkpoint therapy response.

off_label.title: Redox rewiring in glioblastoma: the thioredoxin system as a precision therapeutic target.
off_label.summary: Targeting the thioredoxin system in glioblastoma tumors could overcome drug resistance and improve treatment outcomes.

off_label.title: Targeting NDUFS4 Disrupts Oxidative Phosphorylation and Induces Ferroptosis in Olaparib-Resistant Prostate Cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking NDUFS4 in olaparib-resistant prostate cancer restores drug sensitivity by disrupting mitochondrial function and triggering ferroptosis.

off_label.title: RAPTOR Silencing Inhibits Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma Progression via Regulation of S100A8/A9 and Urokinase Plasminogen Activator.
off_label.summary: Silencing RAPTOR protein inhibits head and neck cancer progression by reducing tumor-promoting signals and increasing protective immune proteins.

off_label.title: An Open-label, Two-arm, Multicenter, Phase II Randomized Controlled Trial Assessing the Impact of Olanzapine on the Efficacy of First-line Immunotherapy in Patients With Advanced EGFR Mutation-negative Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC).
off_label.summary: Study tests whether adding olanzapine to immunotherapy improves outcomes in advanced lung cancer patients compared to immunotherapy alone.

off_label.title: A novel combination for in vivo breast cancer treatment: TAK1 inhibition combined with metformin and Lentinula edodes compounds synergistically reinvigorates CD8+ T Cells.
off_label.summary: Combining a TAK1 inhibitor, metformin, and mushroom extract boosts immune cells to fight triple-negative breast cancer in mice.

off_label.title: The role of nimodipine in preventing cerebral ischaemia and neurological deterioration in cerebral arteriovenous malformations: a systematic review.
off_label.summary: Nimodipine may help prevent brain damage from blood vessel spasms in patients with arteriovenous malformations, though evidence remains unclear.

off_label.title: Repurposing Drugs for Malaria through a Human Dose Prediction: A Case Study with Berzosertib.
off_label.summary: Researchers predict that an anticancer drug called berzosertib could treat malaria at safe doses lower than those used for cancer therapy.

off_label.title: Loss of JAK1 Function Causes G2-M Cell-Cycle Defects Vulnerable to KIF18A Inhibition.
off_label.summary: Blocking JAK1 in head and neck cancer makes tumors resistant to radiation, but adding a KIF18A inhibitor overcomes this resistance.

biomarkers.title: Bee venom acupuncture therapy ameliorates ulcerative colitis by reducing inflammatory response, oxidative stress, and suppressing the NF-κB/HIF-1α pathway.
biomarkers.summary: Bee venom acupuncture reduces inflammation and oxidative stress in ulcerative colitis by suppressing specific cellular pathways.

biomarkers.title: Preventive Health Behaviours Among Elderly in India: Does Social Capital Matter?
biomarkers.summary: Social connections and community ties help elderly Indians adopt preventive health behaviors like exercise, cancer screening, and vaccinations.

biomarkers.title: Dynamic modulation of intercellular adhesion mediated by matriptase-EPCAM/Trop-2 axes is critical for cell extrusion, division, and collective migration.
biomarkers.summary: Matriptase enzyme controls how cancer cells stick together and move by breaking down adhesion proteins, enabling tumor progression and spread.

biomarkers.title: Sensitive detection of somatic mutations in GC-rich cancer gene promoters.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a new method to detect cancer-driving mutations in hard-to-sequence GC-rich gene promoters, identifying potential driver mutations in breast cancer.

biomarkers.title: The value of preoperative 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose PET/computed tomography combined with contrast-enhanced computed tomography for assessing the resectability of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Combined PET and CT scans help doctors better predict whether pancreatic cancer can be completely removed by surgery.

biomarkers.title: Prognostic value of disease distribution and maximum standardized uptake value in Langerhans cell histiocytosis: correlation with event-free and overall survival.
biomarkers.summary: In Langerhans cell histiocytosis, disease spread patterns and metabolic activity on PET scans predict patient survival outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Impact of PET/computed tomography image reconstruction methods on Hopkins score in therapy response assessment of head and neck cancer patients.
biomarkers.summary: New PET imaging reconstruction methods reliably measure therapy response in head and neck cancer patients using the Hopkins scoring system.

biomarkers.title: Functional dissection of SPOP at the amino acid level reveals a comprehensive functional landscape of variants during tumorigenesis.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers mapped how different mutations in SPOP protein affect its cancer-suppressing or cancer-promoting roles in prostate and endometrial cancers.

biomarkers.title: Contrasting temporal dynamics of fluorescence and photoacoustic signals from Cetuximab-IRDye800 conjugate in EGFR-overexpressing tumors.
biomarkers.summary: A fluorescent antibody drug shows peak imaging power at 3 hours in tumors, then weakens as cells absorb it, revealing optimal timing for cancer detection.

biomarkers.title: HSPCs and Treg cells cooperate to preserve extramedullary hematopoiesis under chronic inflammation.
biomarkers.summary: During chronic inflammation, immune cells called HSPCs and Treg cells work together outside the bone marrow to control inflammation and maintain blood cell production.

biomarkers.title: Loss of the autoimmune risk gene TREX1 reveals a convergence of mechanisms promoting immune tolerance loss and antitumor immunity.
biomarkers.summary: Removing the TREX1 gene boosts immune cells that fight cancer while sharing mechanisms with autoimmune responses, suggesting autoimmune risk genes could improve cancer therapy.

biomarkers.title: CKS1B is a tumor-intrinsic factor driving CD8+ T cell exhaustion via maintaining persistent tumor-antigen stimulation.
biomarkers.summary: CKS1B protein in esophageal cancer tumors exhausts immune cells; blocking it restores anti-tumor immunity and improves checkpoint therapy.

biomarkers.title: Decreases in human papillomavirus vaccine types 16 and 18 in cervical precancers - HPV-IMPACT, 2008-2019.
biomarkers.summary: HPV vaccination significantly reduced cervical precancer cases caused by HPV types 16 and 18 between 2008 and 2019.

biomarkers.title: Unraveling the allosteric mechanism and mechanical stability of partial and complete loss-of-function mutations in p53 DNA-binding domain.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified how different p53 mutations weaken cancer-fighting protein structure through distinct mechanisms, offering insights for targeted cancer treatments.

biomarkers.title: CD59 promotes pancreatic cancer progression via a tumor cell-intrinsic JAK2-STAT3 signaling axis.
biomarkers.summary: CD59 promotes pancreatic cancer growth by activating JAK2-STAT3 signaling, and blocking it enhances KRAS inhibitor effectiveness.

trials.title: Spirituality and religiosity in cancer care: A targeted review of the NCCN distress thermometer and implications for holistic screening.
trials.summary: Cancer care providers often miss spiritual and religious distress because screening tools don't effectively capture or address these patient concerns.

trials.title: The value of preoperative 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose PET/computed tomography combined with contrast-enhanced computed tomography for assessing the resectability of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
trials.summary: Combined PET and CT scans help doctors better predict whether pancreatic cancer can be completely removed by surgery.

trials.title: Prognostic value of disease distribution and maximum standardized uptake value in Langerhans cell histiocytosis: correlation with event-free and overall survival.
trials.summary: In Langerhans cell histiocytosis, disease spread patterns and metabolic activity on PET scans predict patient survival outcomes.

trials.title: Impact of PET/computed tomography image reconstruction methods on Hopkins score in therapy response assessment of head and neck cancer patients.
trials.summary: New PET imaging reconstruction methods reliably measure therapy response in head and neck cancer patients using the Hopkins scoring system.

trials.title: Loss of the autoimmune risk gene TREX1 reveals a convergence of mechanisms promoting immune tolerance loss and antitumor immunity.
trials.summary: Removing the TREX1 gene boosts immune cells that fight cancer while sharing mechanisms with autoimmune responses, suggesting autoimmune risk genes could improve cancer therapy.

trials.title: Decreases in human papillomavirus vaccine types 16 and 18 in cervical precancers - HPV-IMPACT, 2008-2019.
trials.summary: HPV vaccination significantly reduced cervical precancer cases caused by HPV types 16 and 18 between 2008 and 2019.

trials.title: Intravenous Immunoglobulin Reduces Infections for Patients with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia: A Single-Center Retrospective Analysis.
trials.summary: IVIG treatment reduces serious infections by 67% in chronic lymphocytic leukemia patients with low antibody levels.

trials.title: [Initial clinical experience with ribociclib in advanced HR+/HER2- breast cancer in Uruguay].
trials.summary: Ribociclib treatment improved survival outcomes in Uruguayan women with advanced hormone-receptor-positive breast cancer.

trials.title: Survival, Toxicity, and Economic Outcomes of Osimertinib Versus Second-Generation Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor-Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors in Metastatic Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor-Mutant Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer.
trials.summary: Osimertinib improves survival and reduces side effects compared to older EGFR drugs in advanced lung cancer patients.

trials.title: Polymeric rapamycin nanoparticles encapsulating ponatinib cause regression of venous malformations in mice.
trials.summary: A single nanoparticle injection combining two drugs caused significant venous malformation regression in mice without toxicity.

trials.title: CD39+CD49a+CD103+ cytotoxic tissue-resident natural killer cells infiltrate and control solid epithelial tumor growth in mice.
trials.summary: Tissue-resident natural killer cells marked by CD39, CD49a, and CD103 effectively infiltrate and kill solid tumors, offering promise for cancer immunotherapy.

trials.title: Globodera pallida virulence on major potato resistance has a common genetic basis across Western Europe.
trials.summary: A common genetic mutation helps potato nematodes overcome resistance across Western Europe, enabling new diagnostic tools for farmers.

trials.title: Dutasteride treatment and its effect on standardized uptake values in prostate-specific membrane antigen-PET imaging: A pilot study.
trials.summary: Dutasteride treatment increased PSMA expression in prostate cancer patients, potentially improving the effectiveness of PSMA-PET imaging for detection.

trials.title: Robust disease prognosis via diagnostic knowledge preservation: A sequential learning approach.
trials.summary: Researchers improved disease prediction for knee osteoarthritis, Alzheimer's, and breast cancer by using diagnostic data while preserving diagnostic accuracy through sequential learning.

trials.title: Risk Stratification Tools for Thyroid Cancer: A Systematic Review of Models Combining Ultrasound, Cytology, and Clinical Risk Factors.
trials.summary: Combined ultrasound, lab tests, and clinical factors improve doctors' ability to predict thyroid cancer risk and guide treatment decisions.
